milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate to the cobblestone building (entrance at ~4,0,5) and look inside to see the powered rail at ~5,0,7. The target is set to [5, 0, 7] (the powered rail's spawn-relative coordinates), max_distance=16 allows detection from a reasonable exploration range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the rail (not just passing nearby). This correctly models 'player can see the powered rail' without requiring them to stand on top of it.
